summary: The GitHub code security risk assessment and secret risk assessment now show whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories, helping you identify where to extend your security coverage. Organization admins and security managers can start an assessment by going to Assessments under their organization’s Security tab.
takeaways: Organization admins and security managers can start an assessment by going to Assessments under their organization’s Security tab.
This improvement is available in GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team.
It will be available for the secret risk assessment in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.
